'use strict';
console.log(typeof this, this === undefined, Object.keys(this));
function ordinary(this: unknown) {
  console.log(this === undefined);
}
ordinary();

function named() {}
Object.defineProperty(named, 'length', {
  get() { console.log('length'); return 3; },
});
Object.defineProperty(named, 'name', {
  get() { console.log('name'); return 'accessor'; },
});
const bound = named.bind(null);
console.log(bound.name, bound.length);
delete (named as any).name;
Object.setPrototypeOf(named, Object.create(Function.prototype, { name: { value: 'inherited' } }));
console.log(named.bind(null).name);

function numeric() {}
console.log('%i %f', numeric, numeric);
console.log(parseInt(numeric as any), Number.parseFloat(numeric as any));
Object.defineProperty(numeric, 'toString', {
  value() { console.log('string hint'); return '12.5'; },
});
console.log('%i %f', numeric, numeric);
